d: Evelyn tells Doc she's calling off the wedding and just wants to be friends. Before a gig, Toni tells Tamar she's working with new management.
The entire family, including Gabe, gathers for Trina's solo show in Atlanta. Tamar and Vince are told to start fertility treatments to get pregnant.
Tamar starts fertility treatments. Tamar and Towanda tell their husbands about the surrogacy idea. Evelyn opens a life coaching business.
Trina calls a truce with Gabe for the kids and drops her band to focus on her solo career. Toni models for Autism cause at Fashion Week.
Evelyn sets Towanda up on a blind date while Trina starts production on her first music video and asks Gabe to invest.
Trina hustles to get ready for her music video shoot. Traci brushes up on her vocals, and her sisters throw her a surprise birthday party.
Toni asks her sisters to perform with her in St. Lucia while Gabe gets a makeover from Evelyn to prove to Trina he's a changed man.
Mama June's arrest, disappearance and illegal drug use create a family crisis.
